scope.dataset_scope: Gowalla repository-bundled processed split in the author-maintained LightGCN-PyTorch repository

evidence_policy.decision_sources: Direct canonical provider/release/terms pages, official dataset or project records, author-maintained repository files, and original papers only
evidence_policy.locator_only_sources: Third-party mirrors, forks, reproductions, search snippets, and same-name datasets cannot close rights or lineage
evidence_policy.raw_lineage_guard: Repository-bundled processed data and matching repository object IDs do not prove the canonical raw release or its transformation history
evidence_policy.missing_evidence_rule: Missing release, rights, code, argv, seed, count, checksum, or custody evidence remains unresolved and is not inferred

candidate_rows.dataset_scope: Gowalla repository-bundled processed split in LightGCN-PyTorch

authoritative_sources.locator: Dataset information; Dataset statistics; Source (citation); Files; Example of check-in information
supports: Stanford SNAP identifies the Gowalla location-based social-network collection and says the friendship network was collected through the public API
The page reports 6,442,890 check-ins collected from February 2009 through October 2010
The provider names loc-gowalla_totalCheckins.txt.gz as the time-and-location check-in file and shows the user, timestamp, latitude, longitude, and location-ID schema
The provider separates the check-in file from loc-gowalla_edges.txt.gz
does_not_support: An immutable raw-data release number, release timestamp, content length, or checksum
A dataset-specific license or institutional research-use grant
That any exact SNAP archive bytes were the input to ExpoMF, NGCF, or LightGCN

authoritative_sources.locator: Opening assent paragraph; Rules for Online Conduct; Permission to Use Materials
supports: The current site-wide terms state that use of Stanford sites signifies agreement to the terms
The permission section grants a personal, non-exclusive, non-transferable license to access and use the sites
The permission section limits downloading to personal, non-commercial use and otherwise restricts copying, retransmission, distribution, publication, commercial exploitation, and transfer
The terms place the burden of determining permissible use on the user
does_not_support: A Gowalla-specific data license
An affirmative institutional or project research-use grant
Terms in force when the NGCF files were created in 2019 or the LightGCN files were created in 2020
Permission for the public redistribution of the processed NGCF or LightGCN data files

authoritative_sources.locator: Citing SNAP; SNAP network datasets citation
supports: SNAP encourages citation when its datasets are used and supplies a collection citation
does_not_support: A data license, redistribution permission, exact Gowalla release identity, or checksum

supports: The BSD language on this page is expressly presented as the license for SNAP software
does_not_support: Applying the SNAP software BSD license to the Gowalla dataset or its derived processed files

authoritative_sources.locator: PDF page 5, Table 1 and Sections 5.1-5.2; extracted lines 581-642
supports: The cited ExpoMF paper describes Gowalla user-venue check-ins and a preprocessing rule requiring every retained user and venue to have at least 20 check-ins
Its post-preprocessing table reports 57,629 users, 47,198 items, and approximately 2.3 million nonzero interactions
Its own experiment randomly split observed interactions 70/20/10 into train/test/validation
does_not_support: That NGCF consumed the ExpoMF preprocessed archive or ExpoMF split
The preprocessing implementation, convergence semantics, ID-map ordering, PRNG, or seed
The NGCF 80/20 split membership

supports: The ExpoMF authors link Gowalla to the canonical SNAP page
The authors separately link an author-hosted gowalla_pro.zip described as the preprocessed data used in their paper
does_not_support: The archive checksum, member manifest, rights terms, or byte identity
That the NGCF authors used gowalla_pro.zip

supports: NGCF reports Gowalla as 29,858 users, 40,981 items, and 1,027,370 interactions
NGCF describes Gowalla as a check-in dataset obtained from Gowalla and cites Liang et al. 2016
NGCF states a 10-core setting retaining users and items with at least ten interactions
NGCF states that 80 percent of each user's historical interactions are randomly assigned to training and the remainder to test, followed by a random 10 percent validation selection from training
does_not_support: The exact raw archive or intermediary artifact used
Preprocessing code revision, executable command, iteration order, duplicate handling, ID-map order, split PRNG, random seed, rounding, or membership hashes
How the validation subset relates to the two repository files

supports: The NGCF authors' Gowalla data directory directs readers looking for the full dataset to the canonical SNAP Gowalla page
does_not_support: The exact SNAP raw file revision or a byte-level raw-to-NGCF transformation

authoritative_sources.immutable_identity_or_version: NGCF commit a718a4f2df7c3942ca0df6759926975762c61eed; README Git blob c321d9a8ddf55294ca856cddaca5e8d9e8b783a3
supports: The NGCF repository labels Gowalla as a processed dataset
It documents train.txt and test.txt as one user followed by positive item IDs per line
It documents user_list.txt and item_list.txt as original-ID to remapped-ID records
does_not_support: The code or ordering rule that generated the mappings and split
Any dataset-specific license

authoritative_sources.locator: JSON entries for README.md, user_list.txt, item_list.txt, train.txt, and test.txt
supports: Exact Git blob object IDs and byte sizes for the five published NGCF Gowalla files at the pinned commit
does_not_support: A provider-published checksum, SHA-256, file contents, or raw lineage

does_not_support: A preprocessing implementation, command, configuration, or custody receipt preceding the upload

supports: LightGCN reports the same 29,858 users, 40,981 items, and 1,027,370 interactions for Gowalla
The LightGCN authors state that they requested the experimented datasets including train/test splits from the NGCF authors and that Gowalla is exactly the same as used in the NGCF paper

authoritative_sources.locator: JSON entries for README.md, user_list.txt, item_list.txt, train.txt, test.txt, s_adj_mat.npz, and s_pre_adj_mat.npz
supports: The LightGCN directory carries the same Git blob IDs and byte sizes as NGCF for README.md, user_list.txt, item_list.txt, train.txt, and test.txt
The pinned directory additionally contains two adjacency-cache NPZ objects with separately identified Git blobs
does_not_support: A provider raw checksum or proof that the cached adjacency objects were regenerated from the pinned train split under a recorded environment

authoritative_sources.locator: Commit add gowalla; train.txt path-history replay
supports: Public Git path history identifies this as the LightGCN train.txt introduction commit
does_not_support: The transfer mechanism, preprocessing run, or upstream raw custody

supports: The pinned LightGCN loader consumes pre-existing train.txt and test.txt files, interpreting each line as a user ID followed by integer item IDs
The loader derives user/item cardinalities from maximum remapped IDs and counts interactions while loading
does_not_support: Any raw preprocessing, filtering, mapping generation, or train/test split generation

authoritative_sources.locator: README Dataset and Gowalla invocation, lines 32-44; seed note line 71
supports: The repository calls Gowalla a processed dataset and publishes the consumer invocation cd code && python main.py --decay=1e-4 --lr=0.001 --layer=3 --seed=2020 --dataset=gowalla --topks=[20] --recdim=64
The seed is documented for LightGCN runtime reproducibility
does_not_support: That seed 2020 generated the NGCF train/test split
A raw preprocessing argv or configuration

cited_upstream_intermediate.surface: ExpoMF Gowalla preprocessing described by Liang et al. and an author-hosted gowalla_pro.zip link
cited_upstream_intermediate.paper_rule: Retain users and venues with at least 20 check-ins

ngcf_published_transformation_policy.filter: 10-core retaining users and items with at least ten interactions
ngcf_published_transformation_policy.interaction_polarity: Each observed user-item interaction is positive
ngcf_published_transformation_policy.train_test_split: For each user, randomly select 80 percent of historical interactions for training and use the remainder for test
ngcf_published_transformation_policy.validation_split: Randomly select 10 percent of training interactions for validation

processed_repository_objects.identity_conclusion: The author-repository metadata establishes exact Git-object identity for the processed split, ID maps, and provider-link README between the pinned NGCF and LightGCN revisions
processed_repository_objects.identity_limit: Git-object identity closes only the NGCF-to-LightGCN repository transfer edge; it does not close the SNAP-to-processed edge

lightgcn_consumer_binding.format: Each nonempty line is an integer user ID followed by integer item IDs; IDs are expected to start at zero
lightgcn_consumer_binding.seed_scope: LightGCN runtime seed only; not evidence of the upstream NGCF split seed

non_dispositive_tensions.tension: ExpoMF documents a 20-check-in filter and 70/20/10 split, while NGCF documents a 10-core filter and per-user 80/20 split followed by validation sampling
non_dispositive_tensions.resolution: These are distinct published protocols. Citation to ExpoMF does not prove that its split or archive was reused; the actual NGCF parent artifact remains unbound.

non_dispositive_tensions.tension: The current Stanford site-wide terms restrict transfer and redistribution while NGCF and LightGCN publicly contain derived processed files
non_dispositive_tensions.resolution: No historical terms or separate provider permission were located, so the rights chain is unresolved rather than adjudicated as a dispositive violation.

non_dispositive_tensions.tension: NGCF describes a validation subset, but its published Gowalla directory and the identical LightGCN directory expose no separate validation file
non_dispositive_tensions.resolution: The relationship between validation membership and the published train.txt file is not documented and remains unresolved.

unresolved_fields: Dataset-specific lawful-use grant for the exact SNAP Gowalla bytes and its scope for institutional research
Release-specific terms in force when the upstream data were obtained, including any separate permission not visible on the current provider page
Exact immutable SNAP raw release, byte length, checksum, retrieval timestamp, and chain-of-custody receipt
Whether NGCF started from loc-gowalla_totalCheckins.txt.gz directly, the ExpoMF gowalla_pro.zip artifact, or another author-supplied intermediate
Checksum and member manifest of the author-hosted ExpoMF gowalla_pro.zip artifact
Raw check-in parsing rules, malformed-row handling, timestamp or coordinate use, and location-ID normalization
Repeated user-venue check-in aggregation or deduplication semantics and the exact definition of one NGCF interaction
Whether and how the ExpoMF 20-check-in preprocessing participates in the NGCF lineage
10-core implementation, fixpoint behavior, user/item pruning order, tie behavior, and code revision
Original-to-remapped user and item ID assignment algorithm, ordering, determinism, and generation code
Preprocessing executable, argv, configuration, dependency environment, and run log
Per-user 80/20 split PRNG implementation, seed, shuffle order, rounding rule, and exact membership
Validation PRNG, seed, membership, and whether validation interactions remain in repository train.txt
Authoritative train, test, and validation interaction counts for the exact public objects without opening or executing them
Cryptographic SHA-256 or stronger hashes for acquired raw, intermediate, map, train, test, and validation bytes
Affirmative upstream authorization for redistribution of the processed files bundled by NGCF and LightGCN
inferences_forbidden: Do not infer lawful research use or redistribution permission from public HTTP or GitHub accessibility
Do not apply the SNAP software BSD license or the NGCF software MIT license to Gowalla data without an explicit data-scope statement
Do not infer canonical raw lineage from matching NGCF and LightGCN processed Git objects
Do not infer that the ExpoMF preprocessed ZIP was NGCF's input merely because NGCF cites the ExpoMF paper
Do not infer that LightGCN seed 2020 is the NGCF preprocessing or split seed
Do not infer split counts, membership, or validation handling from the total interaction count
Do not treat Git SHA-1 blob object IDs as provider-published raw-data checksums
Do not infer historical provider terms from the current mutable Stanford terms page
Do not interpret failure to locate a checksum or separate permission as proof that none has ever existed
